postings.title: Security Operations Engineer
postings.location: New York, New York, United States
postings.description:
About the Position

We are looking for an enthusiastic, motivated, and technically curious individual—with an IT operations focus—to join Jane Street’s IT Security team, and contribute to securing our firm's IT computing platforms and identities. This will involve technical hands-on work, creative problem-solving, and collaboration across teams.

Additional responsibilities of this role will include: 

- Deploying, documenting, and implementing security controls at scale

- Acting as a key component to our Vulnerability Management program to ensure we’re detecting and mitigating vulnerabilities

- Providing guidance and support to the broader IT department and IT Operations team as security incidents arise

- Developing both technical and non-technical solutions in collaboration with engineering teams to address security concerns

- Contributing to the development of our team’s operational playbooks and procedures

We’re looking for someone who loves collaborating alongside others, enjoys triaging complex problems, and is able to delegate and escalate tasks effectively. This role is anything but siloed—you will be a key communicator, translating complex technical issues for various audiences while maintaining a high level of technical accuracy. 

While we’re open to individuals from a range of backgrounds, someone who’s worked in a code-driven or declarative environment and has hands-on experience with security incident response is preferred. 

About You

- Have 5-7 years of experience as a security or operations engineer, with a technical background rooted in Windows

- Can maintain, support, and administer Windows, macOS, and hybrid identity platforms

- Have demonstrated knowledge of typical attack patterns, adversary methods, and protective technologies utilized to mitigate related risks

- Strong troubleshooter and debugger; familiar with trending and log analysis, and have hands-on experience using system performance tools to identify production disruptions 

- Can deploy and implement Endpoint Security controls in highly available environments (e.g., application control, log aggregation, host-based firewalls, EDR, disk encryption)

- Can use PowerShell scripting to automate security tasks and to analyze data at an intermediate level

- Excellent written and verbal communicator

- Able to navigate ambiguity and changing priorities with confidence

- Collaborative and approachable; eager to be a team player

- Having knowledge of macOS security fundamentals is a plus

If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to agency-partnerships@janestreet.com.

postings.title: Senior Financial Reporting Accountant
postings.description:
About the Position

We are looking for an experienced accountant to join our Financial Reporting team. In this role, you will primarily maintain the books and records for our APAC businesses and work with our regional and global accounting teams to review monthly and annual financial statements.

Additional responsibilities of the role will include:

- Reviewing various accounting reconciliations and financial schedules that support the financial statements

- Collaborating with outside auditors and advisors on accounting policy decisions, GAAP interpretations and internal control documentation and decisions

- Working closely with other team members, including members of our accounting-specific technology team, to improve processes and ensure the team’s goals are met

At Jane Street, we always look for the best solutions to complex problems—and that mindset extends to our accounting function. Since our legal and regulatory environment is constantly shifting, we are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented person who can jump into our fast-paced environment and take ownership of delivering high-quality work on time. 

About You

- Have a bachelor’s degree and are a qualified accountant with relevant accountancy credentials

- Have 10+ years of experience in an accounting role (a mix of private and public preferred), including experience with reviewing financial statements and account reconciliations

- Familiar with the relevant regulatory regimes and have in-depth knowledge of either US GAAP or IFRS, as well as a comprehensive understanding of financial statements and legal entity reporting 

- Able to research and interpret relevant/complex accounting literature; experienced in the preparation of technical accounting papers

- Self-motivated to improve processes where possible

- Organised with great communication skills; able to build strong collaborative relationships across various groups within the firm

- Have excellent time management skills; able to handle competing priorities and work effectively in a challenging, fast-paced environment

- A strong analytical and critical thinker; detail-oriented with a “can-do” attitude when resolving issues

- Proficient with Microsoft Excel

- Having experience with accounting and reporting using Workday is a plus 

- Fluent in English

If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to agency-partnerships@janestreet.com

postings.title: Senior Network Engineer
postings.description:
About the Position

We are looking for a Senior Network Engineer who can help us scale our networks to meet increasing business demands, drive standardisation through automation and look for opportunities to leverage AI to improve operations.

Jane Street’s numerous distributed systems run on a multi-vendor, highly available network infrastructure and handle a variety of traffic profiles – from high-speed trading to everyday internet connectivity. A typical day on the Network Engineering team includes:

- Collaborating on new data centre and colocation initiatives, WAN routing optimisation and other cross-team design projects

- Interfacing with stakeholders to assess business needs and develop innovative network features/capabilities

- Leading both reactive support tasks and proactive infrastructure improvements, focusing on thorough documentation to reduce outages and enhance troubleshooting

- Exploring AI/ML-driven enhancements to streamline operations and continuously improve service quality Using your networking expertise to help us scale our team’s infrastructure at large while maintaining high standards for network performance and reliability

- Documenting solutions and processes that help the team work more efficiently, using a meticulous attention to detail

If you have a passion for innovating within a complex network ecosystem, enjoy building scalable systems and documentation structures and are curious about how AI can refine network operations, this role provides a platform to make a significant impact at Jane Street. We look forward to learning from your expertise and unique perspective.

About You

- Have 7+ years of experience operating and deploying network infrastructure, with 3+ years dedicated to ground-up network design

- Have deep experience with routing and network protocols (OSPF, BGP, PIM-SM) and the troubleshooting of transport protocols (TCP/UDP)

- Comfortable operating in Linux environments and proficient in at least one programming language

- Strongly inclined to automate workflows and explore AI/ML approaches to improve efficiency or reduce overhead

- Eager to produce comprehensive, scalable documentation that benefits the entire team

- Have a demonstrated ability to balance multiple priorities, switch contexts effectively and maintain a high level of customer service

- Excellent collaborator and communicator; ready to build strong partnerships with diverse global teams and stakeholders to share your recommendations, issues and outcomes 

- Have a flexible, reliable mindset and enthusiasm for sharing knowledge with peers

- Any prior exposure to overlay networks (EVPN, VXLAN) is a plus

- Fluency in English required

If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to agency-partnerships@janestreet.com.

postings.title: Software Engineer
postings.description:
About the Position

We’re looking for Software Engineers who want to help us design and build the systems and tools that run the firm. You’ll find Software Engineers in all parts of Jane Street, solving real problems in critical areas ranging from trading desks to our accounting team, as well as building foundational infrastructure, whether that means implementing network monitoring or risk models. 

We are big believers in functional programming and, using OCaml, a statically -typed functional programming language, as our primary tool. More recently, Python has become a vital part of Jane Street’s research and trading work, acting as the go-to language for data analysis, visualization, and machine learning. 

Beyond our own environment, we also recognize the value of open source software, leveraging it in our daily work and releasing over a million lines of our own code as open source. We’re also always looking for ways to expand open source projects, and provide ongoing support to things like Mercurial, the OCaml compiler, and the OPAM package manager. That said, we’re interested in talented engineers with experience in any language—most of us came in with little to no practical experience in OCaml before we joined.

If you’d like to learn more, you can read about our interview process and meet some of our newest hires.

About You

We don’t expect you to have a background in functional programming, OCaml, Python, finance, or any other specific field—we’re looking for smart programmers who enjoy solving interesting problems. We’re more interested in how you think and learn than what you currently know. You should be:

- A top-notch programmer with a love for technology

- Intellectually curious, collaborative, and eager to learn

- Humble and unafraid to ask questions and admit mistakes

- Fluent in English

If you'd like to get an idea of what we cover in our software engineering interview process, you can visit our interview prep page.

If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to agency-partnerships@janestreet.com.

postings.title: Software Engineer
postings.description:
About the Position

Our goal is to give you a real sense of what it's like to work at Jane Street full time while also providing a truly unparalleled educational experience. As an intern, you are paired with full-time employees who act as mentors, collaborating with you on real-world projects we actually need done.

As a Software Engineering intern, you'll learn how we use OCaml (our primary development language) in our day-to-day work, and gain exposure to the libraries and tools that are foundational to our internal systems. Some teams also use Python, so depending on the project, you might do some work with Python as well.

During the internship, you'll be closely mentored by full-time software engineers. Mentors design intern projects based on their team's current needs and are heavily invested in helping interns build maintainable, high-quality software that is intended to reach production. The projects you will work on are as varied and diverse as those full-timers work on, covering a wide range of problems, from high-performance trading systems to programming language design and everything in between.

If you’d like to learn more, you can read about our interview and team placement processes and get a sense of what our most recent intern projects looked like! You can also learn more about Jane Street’s internship program here.

About You

If you've never thought about a career in finance, you're in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind, a collaborative spirit, and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you'll fit right in. We're more interested in how you think and learn than what you currently know. You should be:

- A top-notch programmer with a love for technology

- Intellectually curious, collaborative, and eager to learn

- Humble and unafraid to ask questions and admit mistakes

- Fluent in English

postings.title: Software Engineer / Writer
postings.location: New York, New York, United States
postings.description:
About the Position

We're looking to hire a programmer-who-writes, or a writer-who-codes.

Here are the kinds of things we’d like to have this person work on:

- Documentation. We’ve always believed that developers should spend time and effort documenting their own code, but at the same time, a great writer with a feel for the technology can raise the level of quality in a way that few developers can. Establishing a culture of great docs is especially important as we grow.

- Building tools that support documentation. So much documentation is auto-generated by our systems, whether as error messages, logs, automated emails, or library docstrings. Getting your hands dirty hacking on documentation-adjacent tools will help not just to a first order, but will also make your other writing more effective.

- Training material. We have a ton of programs that new and experienced hires go through, ranging from an OCaml Bootcamp to Dev Teach-ins that expose students to interesting technical problems from around the company. Part of the job is to make these better and mint more of them where valuable.

- Writing longer pieces. We need more tutorials and overviews on a variety of topics. We have an internal developer handbook that we’re writing, with a backlog of chapters—each one an opportunity to dive deep into some part of our stack. But there’s also a lot of external writing to be done, for instance on our blog, our programming podcast, for conferences, recruiting events, and more.

In terms of skills, we want someone who is both an excellent writer and good enough at programming to navigate our codebase, work through our tutorials, and write up examples. You might spend meaningful time embedded as an engineer on one of our projects, just to understand how we write software. But experience with functional programming, expressive type systems, OCaml, or finance are all unnecessary—we’re happy to teach you about these things here.

If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to agency-partnerships@janestreet.com.

postings.title: Strategy and Product
postings.description:
About the Position

SPs are versatile generalists who take a deeply analytical and strategic approach to solving Jane Street’s most pressing problems. They move across groups as firm priorities evolve, developing a holistic view of our business and driving cross-functional growth. 

As an SP Intern, you'll work on projects that combine big-picture thinking with rigorous analytical problem-solving. You'll learn to break down complex challenges into actionable steps, use data to inform decisions, and build frameworks to tackle business questions. This hands-on experience will give you direct insight into how SPs lead strategic initiatives across the organization and leave you with a strong grasp of what an SP career looks like.

To learn more, you can explore our Strategy and Product program, interview process and see examples of recent intern projects. You can also learn more about Jane Street's internship program here.

About You

We don’t expect you to have a background in finance or any other specific field — we’re looking for smart people who enjoy solving interesting problems. We’re more concerned with how you think and learn than what you currently know. You should be:

- Someone who excels at taking a structured and detailed approach to solving problems, communicates effectively, can drive projects forward, and has exceptional attention to detail

- Excited to learn about a wide range of disciplines and subject matter, including global market dynamics, technical systems and tooling, operational infrastructure, and more 

- Eager to ask questions, admit mistakes, and constantly deepen your understanding

- Available to start working full-time in 2028

- Fluent in English

Please note: Jane Street will provide flights to and from Hong Kong as well as accommodation throughout the entirety of the program.

postings.location: New York, New York, United States
postings.description:
About the Position

We are looking for enthusiastic Teaching Assistants with strong backgrounds in mathematics, computer science, or a related quantitative field for our Academy of Math and Programming (AMP) in New York City.

This is a temporary, six-week summer role, including one week of training before the five-week student program. AMP is a residential program serving recent high school graduates of diverse backgrounds who have experienced barriers to access and opportunity within advanced STEM education.

Students study mathematics, computer programming, data analysis, and game theory through challenging and interactive classes, problem-solving sessions, and games. You will work alongside instructors and other teaching assistants to support students in the classroom and help supervise the residential program.

Teaching Assistants support both the mathematics and computer science curricula. We do not expect everyone to have equal depth across every topic. It’s fine if you have greater experience in one subject, as long as you are excited to support both subjects and learn alongside the instructional team.

Additional responsibilities will include:

- Helping instructors deliver lessons in areas such as combinatorics, number theory, algorithms, programming, and software development

- Working with students individually and in small groups during classes, problem-solving sessions, and study hours

- Supporting classroom supervision, assignment review, and other academic coordination

- Teaching, guiding, and playing strategy games with students

- Residing with students in the dormitory for the duration of the program and serving as an active, responsible program leader beyond the classroom, supporting student well-being and reinforcing community expectations 

- Leading academic and social activities during evenings and select weekends

Jane Street deeply values the quality of our educational programming, and we compensate our high-caliber staff accordingly. Travel, housing, and on-site meals will be provided.

About You

- An undergraduate student in mathematics, computer science, or a related field

- Experienced with, or interested in, working with students in an academic or residential setting

- Have a strong background in mathematics, computer science, or both; it is fine to have greater depth in one subject than the other

- Comfortable with foundational programming and mathematical problem-solving, and willing to learn beyond your primary area of expertise

- A patient and encouraging communicator who enjoys helping students work through challenging material

- Exercises sound judgment, maintains clear boundaries, and handles sensitive student matters discreetly, escalating concerns when appropriate

postings.title: Technical Product Manager
postings.location: New York, New York, United States
postings.description:
About the Position

We are looking for a highly-driven Technical Product Manager who can provide organization and coordination support for our engineering initiatives. Technology is core to our business, and this role is an opportunity to work alongside our engineers as we build and optimize Jane Street’s trading technology.

You’ll draw from your technical background on a daily basis, leading projects through their entire lifecycle, including defining goals, developing timelines, tracking milestones, managing developer time, identifying risks, and coordinating with related teams. You’ll also communicate project schedules, priorities, and status updates to the larger organization.

Strong communication skills and the ability to manage competing priorities will be necessary to collaborate across a wide range of teams at Jane Street—including developers, business teams, operations, support—as well as with external financial entities, to make sure each project is delivered on time and meets or exceeds stated goals and expectations.

We operate in a flexible problem-solving environment that encourages people to think outside the box when developing processes and tools for the project at hand. The person in this role needs to be a strategic thinker who considers the goals of the group and project when problem solving.

postings.title: Tools and Compilers Research and Development
postings.location: New York, New York, United States
postings.description:
About the position

We are excited to announce research internships in our Tools and Compilers group. We're looking for PhD and masters students with outstanding research experience in programming languages, compilers, verification, and related areas.

Jane Street's Compilers team focuses on improving OCaml as a foundation for Jane Street's ever-growing technology stack, in collaboration with the greater OCaml community. We work on many different aspects of the compiler, aiming to make it easier for developers to express their ideas in OCaml, to improve the performance of the generated code, and to make the OCaml compiler itself faster and easier to use.

Over the years, we extended the type system with support for novel language features, re-engineered the optimizer ground-up, and added feedback-directed optimization. We also extend and enhance the surrounding toolchain, working on tools for profiling, debugging, documenting, and building automation. The vast majority of our work is open-source, and we upstream as much as we can to the mainstream OCaml compiler.

During the internship, you will work in collaboration with your mentors on one project for about 10-12 weeks. You'll learn how we use OCaml in our day-to-day work, and gain exposure to the libraries and tools that are foundational to our internal systems. You'll gain a better understanding of the wide range of problems we solve every day. You'll try out new ideas and apply state-of-the-art research to a large actively-developed production codebase.

We'll pick a project that combines your research background with our active work on the OCaml compiler and core libraries. Example project areas include:

- Type systems that track locality and uniqueness

- Formal verification of OCaml programs

- New language features for systems programming

- Compiler testing and validation

You'll also be able to access our physical and virtual educational resources, attend guest speakers and social events, and hopefully get a real sense of what it would be like to work here full-time.

About you

We're looking for PhD and masters students with outstanding research experience in programming languages, compilers, verification, and related areas. We don't expect you to have a background in finance, OCaml, or functional programming. Please include the list of your peer-reviewed publications in your resume.

postings.title: Trading Desk Operations Engineer
postings.description:
About the position

We are looking for individuals eager to use their technical, organizational, and communication skills in a fast-paced environment to join our TDOE team. Our TDOE's are integral to the firm’s success, building and maintaining desk infrastructure that supports the trading of thousands of financial products across 200 venues in over 45 countries.

Trading Desk Operations Engineers wear many hats, helping to manage the operational side of the trading desk’s activities and interfacing with various groups within the firm to ensure our work is accurate and efficient. You’ll work alongside traders and developers to take on projects like: 

- Managing and optimizing infrastructure and operational processes

- Supporting trading systems and workflows by executing data queries and coordinating with stakeholders

- Designing and implementing solutions for a range of trading and operational related issues on the desk 

- Communicating with clearing firms and external counterparties to settle and clear trades

Our trading desks are central to our collaborative office environment, and we believe the best way to integrate new hires is through a hands-on, interactive approach. You’ll receive mentorship from other TDOEs, traders, and developers as you take part in a number of development and training programs over your first few months. We don’t expect you to have a background in finance or any other specific field — we’re looking for curious people who enjoy solving interesting problems. We’re more interested in how you think and learn than what you currently know. 

It’s important to emphasize the hands-on nature of this role; you’ll be building the tools that allow our firm to operate smoothly and execute trades efficiently. You’ll utilize technical coding, skilled organization, and collaborative problem-solving to deliver smart, innovative solutions that make our trading better. 

We believe that good ideas come from anywhere and are always open to new ways of thinking. The impact you will have on the firm will only increase as you gain experience and proficiency in your specific expertise. 

About you

- A critical thinker with a strong technical foundation and an interest in expanding your programming skills

- Able to use technical knowledge and strong collaboration skills to reach solutions

- An agile and adaptive problem solver

- Humble about what you know and don’t know; eager to ask questions and learn new things

- A reliable team player with a “no job too small” attitude

- Excellent verbal and written communication

- Able to balance competing priorities in a fast-paced environment

- Interested in finance and has a passion for STEM

- Fluent in English

If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to agency-partnerships@janestreet.com.

postings.title: Trading Desk Operations Engineer
postings.description:
About the position

Trading Desk Operations Engineers (TDOEs) keep our trading desks running. On a given day, a TDOE might investigate an outage in a critical system, write code, often with AI tools, to automate an error-prone process, or sit with a trader to build a dashboard together. The job is a balance between steadily making workflows and systems more resilient and meeting the urgent needs of trading.

Our TDOE internship is an immersive program built around real-world projects directly tied to the challenges we face on the desk every day, all guided by dedicated TDOE mentors. The summer has three main parts:

- Bootcamp: You’ll start with two weeks of classes on the technologies we use on the desk and the basics of market making. Our introductory programming curriculum covers languages from Bash to OCaml, and no prior experience is required. Classes on the products we trade and the tools we use continue well past bootcamp. 

- Projects: You’ll work on several projects with different mentors. Recent interns built a tool that flags discrepancies between our records of voice trades and the public tape, implemented a new exchange order type after working through two exchanges' conflicting rulebooks, and built a UI showing when ETFs can be traded and settled around holidays in dozens of markets. Many intern tools reach daily use on the desk. 

- Operations: Alongside your projects, you'll take support rotations and handle the kinds of requests TDOEs field every day. They range from fixing a script that didn't run to pulling data a trader needs before earnings. You'll also support a simulated trading portfolio, building your own tools to book its trades, check its positions, and follow each trade through its life cycle. 

Our goal is to give you a real sense of what it's like to work at Jane Street full time while providing an unparalleled educational experience. For more, read about the TDOE program, see what our most recent interns built, or check out Jane Street's internship program. We can't wait to teach you what we know, and learn a few things from you as well!

About you

If you've never thought about a career in finance, you're in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind, a collaborative spirit, and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you'll fit right in. We're more interested in how you think and learn than what you currently know.

- Planning to graduate in 2027 or 2028, all backgrounds are welcome! 

- A critical thinker with a strong quantitative foundation and an interest in programming 

- A team player with a "no job too small" attitude

- Able to balance competing priorities in a fast-paced environment

- Proactive, organized, reliable, and courteous 

- A clear communicator, in writing and in person

- Intellectually humble; eager to ask questions and learn new things

- Fluent in English

Please note: Jane Street will provide flights to and from Hong Kong as well as accommodation throughout the entirety of the program.

postings.title: Unified Communications Engineer
postings.description:
About the position

We are looking for a Unified Communications (UC) Engineer to help grow, monitor and manage our global voice and video infrastructure. This role sits within our larger IT group and will require you to deliver smart solutions in a fast-paced environment without disrupting the daily workflow.

The UC team is responsible for all tasks and infrastructure related to collaboration and telephony. Projects include improving tooling and monitoring, deploying UC products and services, and executing software and hardware configuration changes globally, all while minimising downtime for various collaboration services.

Our UC Engineers are experts at multitasking, monitoring alarms generated by our voice and video systems, juggling project-related tasks and serving as an escalation point for users and other technology groups. You’ll interface daily with various tech teams across the firm—including IT Operations, Cybersecurity and Networking—to provide capacity planning, develop standards and best practices and improve documentation across our global UC infrastructure. 

The right candidate will be passionate about solving complex problems and supporting users with robust and flexible technical solutions. 

About you

- Have 7+ years of in-depth experience configuring and supporting the Cisco UC and Collaboration Product Suite in a multi-cluster environment, including:

- Cisco Unified Communications Manager versions 14+

- Cisco Meeting Server

- Cisco Expressway

- Have excellent knowledge of SIP, including implementing Session Border Controllers and PSTN SIP trunking

- Deeply experienced with upgrading and maintaining Cisco UC products, including supporting phones, softphones and video conferencing endpoints

- Knowledgeable about UC compliance products, and experienced with modern voice recording platforms (Verint, NiCE, Red Box, etc.) and messaging archiving products (Movius, LeapXpert, Smarsh, etc.)

- Knowledgeable about Cisco APIs related to UC products, and experienced with creating API automations using Python, PowerShell, etc.

- Experienced with integrating cloud-based conferencing technologies (Webex, Zoom, Teams, etc.) with on-premise infrastructure

- Comfortable troubleshooting custom API-based integrations with UC products and services

- Able to collect and interpret log files, collaborate with support partners to solve problems while maintaining system stability and properly manage expectations with colleagues and users

- Familiar with the virtualisation of Cisco UC applications on enterprise-grade servers (HPE, Dell, Cisco, etc.)

postings.title: Unified Communications Engineer
postings.location: New York, New York, United States
postings.description:
About the Position

We are looking for a Unified Communications (UC) Engineer to help grow, monitor, and manage our global voice and video infrastructure. This role sits within our larger IT group and will require you to deliver smart solutions in a fast-paced environment without disrupting the daily workflow.

The UC team is responsible for all tasks and infrastructure related to collaboration and telephony. Projects include improving tooling and monitoring, deploying UC products and services, and executing software and hardware configuration changes globally, all while minimizing downtime for various collaboration services.

Our UC Engineers are experts at multitasking, monitoring alarms generated by our voice and video systems, juggling project-related tasks, and serving as an escalation point for users and other technology groups. You’ll interface daily with various tech teams across the firm—including IT Operations, Cybersecurity, and Networking—to provide capacity planning, develop standards and best practices, and improve documentation across our global UC infrastructure. 

The right candidate will be passionate about solving complex problems and supporting users with robust and flexible technical solutions. 

About You

- Have 7+ years of in-depth experience configuring and supporting the Cisco UC and Collaboration Product Suite in a multi-cluster environment, including:

- Cisco Unified Communications Manager versions 14+

- Cisco Meeting Server

- Cisco Expressway

- Have excellent knowledge of SIP, including implementing Session Border Controllers and PSTN SIP trunking

- Deeply experienced with upgrading and maintaining Cisco UC products, including supporting phones, softphones, and video conferencing endpoints

- Knowledgeable about UC compliance products, and experienced with modern voice recording platforms (Verint, NiCE, Calabrio, etc.) and messaging archiving products (Movius, LeapXpert, Smarsh, etc.)

- Knowledgeable about Cisco APIs related to UC products, and experienced with creating API automations using Python, PowerShell, etc.

- Experienced with integrating cloud-based conferencing technologies (Webex, Zoom, Teams, etc.) with on-premise infrastructure

- Comfortable troubleshooting custom API-based integrations with UC products and services

- Able to collect and interpret log files, collaborate with support partners to solve problems while maintaining system stability, and properly manage expectations with colleagues and users

- Familiar with the virtualization of Cisco UC applications on enterprise-grade servers (HPE, Dell, Cisco, etc.)

- Have a strong understanding of current security standards and expectations, and an ability to troubleshoot and use creative thinking to resolve issues

If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to agency-partnerships@janestreet.com.

postings.title: Windows Engineer
postings.description:
About the position

Our goal is to give you a real sense of what it's like to work at Jane Street full time while also providing a truly unparalleled educational experience. As an intern, you are paired with full-time employees who act as mentors, collaborating with you on real-world projects we actually need done.

As a Windows Engineering intern, you'll work side by side with full-timers in the IT department to learn how we design, deploy, secure, and maintain the automation tools and key infrastructure components that are critical to Jane Street's success. Our Windows Engineers manage a combination of systems we've created ourselves, open-source tools meshed together to provide higher-level functions, and integrations with industry-leading third-party tools and platforms. All of these systems serve to support the Windows desktop and server estate, as well as the tech infrastructure across the company, regardless of platform. Our automation tools help Engineers develop solutions and integrations quickly, efficiently, and reliably.

On any given day, you may be brainstorming approaches to improve systems and workflows, writing code, or learning about a new technology our team may want to deploy. You'll also learn how we use OCaml (our primary development language), F# (a similar language used with our Windows systems), and PowerShell (a scripting language used for the majority of our automation in IT) in our day-to-day work, and gain exposure to the libraries and tools that are foundational to our internal systems.

After your initial training, you'll work in tandem with full-timers on projects drawn directly from our team's mission-critical stack. While your projects may vary in scope and content, they could include things like::

- Developing and maintaining tools and applications related to Windows automation and configuration management

- Improving our CI/CD systems, cross-platform frameworks, and software development environments

- Improving the efficiency and scalability of our tools, services, and monitoring solutions

- Implementing editor and workflow improvements to streamline coding and deployment workflows across IT

Learn more about Jane Street's internship program here.

About you

If you've never thought about a career in finance, you're in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind, a collaborative spirit, and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you'll fit right in. We're more interested in how you think and learn than what you currently know. You should be:

- A strong programmer who can demonstrate high potential and an aptitude for learning

- Experienced with .NET languages (C# or F#)

- Knowledgeable in operating system fundamentals and computer architecture

- Able to understand network protocols at a basic level

- Familiar with AI/LLMs and prompt engineering

- Intellectually curious, collaborative, and eager to learn

- Humble and unafraid to ask questions and admit mistakes

- A strong communicator

- As comfortable at the command line as you are in a GUI

- Fluent in English

postings.title: Windows Engineer
postings.description:
About the Position

We are looking to hire a talented engineer to help run our internal Windows infrastructure. We are open to applicants with strong experience in areas such as infrastructure, applications, automation, and server or desktop operating systems in Windows environments. 

Windows is our primary desktop operating system, and many of our core infrastructure services are provided by Windows servers. Having these systems work correctly is key to meeting our business needs for performance and reliability.

You’ll work to improve, automate and standardise our Windows environment. Ideally this means you have experience scripting/programming in either PowerShell, Python or C#. All of our scripts are centrally managed and stored in an organised repository, where they are reviewed by team members and used by many teams across the firm.

As part of a global team, you will also collaborate with colleagues across the firm—locally and abroad—to develop new ideas, find and resolve issues, plan and execute deployments and document the results.

This position sits within our IT Engineering group, a highly dedicated team of engineers who monitor and manage a Windows environment across a physical/virtual computing landscape that spans three continents. Your analytical thinking and expertise will be invaluable as we support the daily work of our colleagues and keep our systems operating at the highest standard. 

 About You

While there’s no fixed set of skills required for this role (we can teach you what you need to know), here are some of the things we’re looking for:

- Advanced experience with the inner workings of Microsoft Windows 10/11 or Microsoft Windows Server 2016/2019/2022

- Experience with using PowerShell (or Python, C#) to automate deployment, configuration and monitoring environments

- Strong working knowledge of Active Directory/Kerberos/DNS/Group Policy

- Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot Windows operating systems and applications

- Experience with hardware monitoring and performance tuning in physical or virtual environments

- Ability to solve complex problems in a fast-paced environment

- Clear and concise communication skills; the ability to maintain a high degree of customer service for all queries

- A flexible, reliable and highly collaborative approach to your work

- Fluency in English 

If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to agency-partnerships@janestreet.com.

postings.title: Workday Financials Specialist
postings.location: New York, New York, United States
postings.description:
About the Position

We are looking for a Workday Financials Specialist to join our global team. We use Workday to support our global Infrastructure and Technology teams, and its flexibility and performance are critical for the firm’s success. You will help with system administration and maintenance, with a particular focus on finding ways to scale and optimize processes by automating Workday tasks and information. You’ll also work closely with members of the Accounting, Procurement, Tax, and Tech teams, as well as system vendors, to meet the accounting technology needs of our firm.

We are a global team, which means day-to-day work will include providing support and enhancements for our overseas offices in addition to supporting our local New York team. 

Additional responsibilities of this role will include:

- Assisting with all system queries and issue resolution

- Helping maintain system workflows and business process approval chains

- Collaborating with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions, conduct testing, and ensure successful user adoption

- Assisting with the design, development, and maintenance of custom reports to address questions and requests from the business

- Auditing and monitoring of data to ensure accuracy

- Creating and updating supporting documentation, such as operational guides, end-user documents, and FAQs

- Executing and/or coordinating testing of new business processes, system modifications, and updates

- Assisting with identifying and facilitating end-user training

- Monitoring upcoming product releases, reviewing release notes, assessing new features, and understanding their impact on business processes and functionality

- Recommending improvement opportunities and continuously innovating across the Workday platform and the firm’s systems 

About You

- Bachelor’s degree preferred

- Have 5+ years of Workday Financials experience

- Understands system design, configuration, and administration with a particular emphasis in Accounting, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Tax and Financial Reporting

- Knowledge of system integrations and how to ensure proper data flow of Financial information to other systems

- Experience with reporting tools and security configuration within Workday

- Self-motivated, demonstrating sound judgment and initiative while keeping others informed as appropriate

- Ability to handle competing priorities and work effectively in a challenging, fast-paced environment

- Detail oriented and organized with strong verbal and written communication skills

- Team player who is collaborative and flexible in nature

- Mature, trustworthy, and discreet, with an appreciation for the importance of confidentiality in this role

If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to agency-partnerships@janestreet.com

postings.title: Workplace Services & Experience – APAC Lead
postings.description:
About the Position

We are looking for a strategic and collaborative Workplace Services and Experience APAC Lead to head our workplace services (WS) functions across Hong Kong and Singapore. This is a senior leadership role focused less on deep technical subject-matter expertise—we already have strong expertise on the ground—and more on providing the vision, people leadership and connective tissue that lets our APAC teams thrive.

You'll set the strategic direction for WS across the region, mentor and develop a growing multi-office team, and act as the primary conduit between APAC and our colleagues in London and New York. You'll bring a calm, collaborative leadership style, set a high bar for service, and help our APAC offices feel like a coherent part of the global Jane Street experience while still reflecting their local context.

Your areas of focus will include:

- Setting the strategic direction for our Workplace Services and Experience team across Hong Kong, Singapore and our growing footprint in the region, in close partnership with global WS leadership

- Building, mentoring and motivating a multi-office team spanning our Operations, Food and Front of House teams

- Acting as the primary conduit between our APAC WS teams and our London and New York counterparts, ensuring alignment, knowledge-sharing and consistent global standards

- Leading vendor strategy across the region: sourcing, selecting, partnering with and managing third-party providers (catering, cleaning and others) to deliver excellent service and value

- Supporting the build-out and opening of new APAC spaces as our footprint grows, partnering with our Engineering, IT and other internal teams

- Owning regional WS budgets and using financial data to make sound operational decisions

- Championing Jane Street's culture across the region, making sure visitors feel welcome and Streeters feel happy, engaged and well supported

- Anticipating and resolving workplace issues proactively, and shaping how WS evolves as our APAC operation grows

This role involves regular travel between our APAC offices. Ideally, you’ll also be willing to spend extended periods embedded in our New York and London offices in your first year to build relationships with global counterparts and ground yourself in how the team operates across the firm.

About You

- Significantly experienced leading workplace services, hospitality, office management or a closely related function (ideally across multiple sites and/or markets)

- A strong people manager first and foremost: someone who has built, developed and motivated teams, is comfortable leading through other managers, and can bring out the best in people across different cultural contexts; You set clear expectations, give and invite direct feedback 

- A strategic thinker with vision: you are able to set direction, prioritise across competing demands and turn ideas into operational reality

- Have a track record of building strategic vendor partnerships, underpinned by strong financial acumen: you are skilled at selecting the right partners, cultivating long-term relationships and bringing out the best in suppliers to deliver excellent service across the region

- A natural conduit, collaborator, and strong communicator: you are skilled at building trust across regions and functions, and at translating between local context and global priorities, with excellent people skills and a genuine hospitality mindset.

- Comfortable in a flat, fast-moving environment with little hierarchy; you thrive on ambiguity and change

- Having familiarity with the APAC market and an existing personal network of hospitality/workplace services professionals across the region is a plus

- Fluent in English; fluency in additional regional languages (Cantonese, Mandarin) is a plus

If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to agency-partnerships@janestreet.com
